note: Ceilings for scripts/app-bundle-budget.mjs. Uncompressed bytes, unioned client chunks per route prefix, measured from a real `next build`. Raising a ceiling is allowed and is meant to be an argument: put what it bought in `why`, in the SAME commit that spends it. Re-measure with `npm run build && node scripts/app-bundle-budget.mjs --record`.

admin.why: Recorded at the commit that introduced this gate: 9.13 MB uncompressed, the union of the client chunks across all 75 routes under the /admin prefix, dominated by the admin shell every one of them shares. pos.why: 8.92 MB uncompressed for the register route's client graph. Headroom is 256 KB, half of admin's, on purpose: this is the tablet-on-venue-wifi surface, and the five POS modes the blueprints specify are supposed to SPLIT this bundle rather than add to it. A mode landing here should show up as a ceiling argument, not as slack already waiting.
